title: Translating finite-domain integer constraint models to CP/SMT/ILP/PB/SAT solvers with CPMpy
abstract: arXiv:2608.15143v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Constraint solving is a declarative approach for solving combinatorial satisfaction and optimization problems. The user specifies their problem through constraints and decision variables, and a generic solver is used to find a solution. Several constraint-solving technologies exist, and certain solvers perform well on certain problems. Therefore, it is useful to try different solvers given a particular application. However, each solving paradigm supports different types of constraints and decision variables.   Our goal is to translate high-level constraint satisfaction and optimization problems into any lower-level formalism, including CP, SMT QF-LIA, ILP, PB and (Max)SAT. This allows for comparing different solving technologies for a particular problem, without requiring a user to manually remodel it for each solving paradigm. translated_title: 将有限域整数约束模型翻译为CP/SMT/ILP/PB/SAT求解器：基于CPMpy的方法
translated_abstract: 约束求解是一种用于解决组合满足和优化问题的声明式方法。用户通过约束和决策变量指定问题，然后使用通用求解器寻找解决方案。目前存在多种约束求解技术，且某些求解器在特定问题上表现优异。因此，针对特定应用尝试不同的求解器是有益的。然而，每种求解范式支持不同类型的约束和决策变量。我们的目标是将高层约束满足和优化问题翻译为任何低层形式体系，包括CP、SMT QF-LIA、ILP、PB和(Max)SAT。这使得能够针对特定问题比较不同的求解技术，而无需用户为每种求解范式手动重新建模。我们定义了一个包含逻辑和算术操作的高层语言，以及有用的附加函数和约束。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CPMpy的自动翻译方法，将高层整数约束模型统一转换为多种底层求解器格式，便于用户无需手动重建模即可比较不同求解技术。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a CPMpy-based automated translation method that converts high-level integer constraint models into multiple low-level solver formats, enabling users to compare different solving technologies without manual remodeling.
